about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a full-stack engineer based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, with 18+ years of experience building software across mobile, web, and desktop — for banks, factories, schools, and beyond. I care about clean architecture, developer experience, and shipping things that actually work.
